title: Separatedness descends along flat surjective quasi-compact morphisms (Stacks 02KU)
statement: Let $g:S'\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] and quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes and let $f':X\times_SS'\to S'$ be the second projection of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $f'$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] (its diagonal $X\times_SS'\to(X\times_SS')\times_{S'}(X\times_SS')$ is a closed immersion), then $f$ is separated.

source.place: Descent, Lemma Tag 02KU (lemma-descending-property-separated, line 5581: 'The property P(f) = "f is separated" is fpqc local on the base'), the direction 'the base change has P => f has P' of Definition Tag 02KO (definition-property-morphisms-local, line 5310) for the one-member fpqc covering $\{g:S'\to S\}$. The one-member family $\{g\}$ is then an fpqc covering of $S$ (Topologies, Lemma Tag 03L7, lemma-recognize-fpqc-covering, topologies.tex line 2904, (2): for an affine open $U\subseteq S$ the open $g^{-1}(U)$ is quasi-compact and $g(g^{-1}(U))=U$)

proof.text: The diagonal of pullback.snd f g is a closed immersion by IsSeparated, hence universally closed by the Mathlib instance instUniversallyClosedOfIsClosedImmersion (Stacks 01W5). Express this as MorphismProperty.diagonal @UniversallyClosed applied to pullback.snd f g using diagonal_iff.

Use MorphismProperty.of_pullback_snd_of_descendsAlong for P = MorphismProperty.diagonal @UniversallyClosed and Q = @Surjective inf @Flat inf @QuasiCompact. The Mathlib instance instDescendsAlongDiagonalOfRespectsIsoOfIsStableUnderBaseChange derives this descent property from descendsAlong_universallyClosed_surjective_inf_flat_inf_quasicompact (the general Mathlib declaration recorded as the match of lem-weil-pbc-universally-closed-affine-descent, used here in its full non-affine form). It internally identifies the base-changed diagonal with the diagonal after base change through canonical pullback isomorphisms. Stability under base change of all three components of Q supplies its remaining premise. Apply diagonal_iff to obtain UniversallyClosed (pullback.diagonal f).

The diagonal is an immersion, hence a preimmersion. Its universally closed structure provides Scheme.Hom.isClosedMap, whose isClosed_range makes its range closed. Apply IsClosedImmersion.of_isPreimmersion to obtain IsClosedImmersion (pullback.diagonal f), and construct IsSeparated f with that proof.
